safety.population: Australian Bureau of Statistics, Census of Population and Housing 2021, usual resident population by SAL

rent.source: NSW Department of Communities and Justice, Rent and Sales Report

percentileDirection.rentAll: High = more expensive. Among suburbs with a DCJ all-dwellings median only (Census fallback excluded).
percentileDirection.rent2Br: High = more expensive. Among suburbs with a DCJ 2-bedroom median.
percentileDirection.safetyAll: High = more recorded incidents per 1,000 residents. Among suburbs with 1,000+ residents.
percentileDirection.transitCoverage: High = more of the suburb within 800 m of a rail, metro, light rail or ferry stop. All suburbs.
percentileDirection.medianAge: High = older. Among suburbs with a Census median age.
